name: Finance - Budget vs Actual Dashboard
description: So sánh ngân sách kế hoạch vs thực tế chi tiêu

native.query: SELECT b.name, b.amount as budget, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) as spent, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0)/b.amount*100,1) as pct FROM fin_budgets b LEFT JOIN fin_expense_requests e ON b.id = e.budget_id AND e.status = 'APPROVED' WHERE b.tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.amount ORDER BY pct DESC

SELECT b.name, b.amount as budget, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) as actual FROM fin_budgets b LEFT JOIN fin_expense_requests e ON b.id = e.budget_id AND e.status = 'APPROVED' AND date_trunc('month', e.created_at) = date_trunc('month', NOW()) WHERE b.tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.amount
